q__mast_sun_earth__table.method: X x L table of sun_earth_pct from centre_mast_schedule.json.gz with S = 2026-11-14T00:00Z. Sense: higher is better. Robust = best worst-case over X; regret(x, l) = best option under x minus option l under x (>= 0). Tie rules: robust best worst-case over the listed members; ties -> best on the nominal member, then the nominal option, then the lowest index; nominal best on the nominal member; ties -> the nominal option, then the lowest index.
q__mast_sun_earth__table.caveat: SOURCE-BASED · UNVALIDATED. "Worst" is the worst of the listed members (nominal + 20 PGDA 78 error clones), a stress test over this scenario set, not a bound over all possible terrain. k of N maps is not a probability: the 20 PGDA 78 clones are deterministic alternates with no weights. Counts are never combined across axes or questions.
